svg.title: Boyong Tang — research profile
svg.desc: Boyong Tang (Kelvin, けるゔぃん・とう). Undergraduate, Applied Mathematics & Artificial Intelligence, Sichuan University, Chengdu. “Observe the unanswered.” Beside the title, a small black-and-white manga panel: rain on a window, books and a cup on the sill.

g.text: rain on the window; the question stays open.
